verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office SaaS covering incorporation, compliance, accounting and mail. A platform of that kind could plausibly offer user-defined automations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions user-built automations, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of them. Its 'we handle it' claims describe done-for-you services, not user-managed automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
